errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that for each year, there is a blue bar and 'an orange rectangle above it' ('оранжев правоъгълник над него'). This implies a stacked bar chart structure. However, the figure is a grouped bar chart, with the blue and orange bars placed side-by-side.

errors.text_span: и всеки е съпроводен с точна числовата стойност на върха
errors.evidence: The description claims that 'всеки' (each/every) bar has its numerical value at the top. This is not correct. Only the blue bars have their values displayed at the top; the orange bars have their values displayed inside the bar itself.
The description of the horizontal axis omits the fact that it is explicitly labeled 'Axis Title'.
